overview: You read the king from the first gage to the castle wall. Two joins are still only marks, "here a messenger" and "here York, angry." You drew a line down the margin of a speech that had been pleasant to write, and you did not copy the speech out and did not strike it.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the papers through to the wall, and drew the line.

assets.name: Richard II
assets.disposition: Read the king to the castle wall and drew a margin line
